text: DuckDB is an in-process analytical database that supports SQL directly on Parquet, CSV and JSON files.
Docker Compose lets you define and run multi-container applications with a single YAML file.
Claude Code skills package reusable instructions and scripts that the assistant can invoke on demand.
Vector embeddings map text into numeric space so that semantically similar passages end up close together.
Retrieval augmented generation grounds a language model's answers in documents fetched from a knowledge base.
